summaryAnalyses.title: What each audience segment reacted to
summaryAnalyses.instruction: For each audience tier (main contractor, subcontractor, developer/client, rental company), summarize in 1-2 sentences what these personas took away from the page and what drove their next step, so the site owner sees how the segments differ. Be faithful and concise; do not invent facts.

distributions.title: Clarity: what it would do for me (1-7)

summaryAnalyses.title: What to change, clustered by audience
summaryAnalyses.instruction: For each audience tier, cluster these suggested changes into at most four concrete themes, ordered by how often they come up. For each theme give a short imperative title and one representative verbatim quote. These are instructions to the website owner, so keep them specific and actionable. Do not invent suggestions that were not made.
